x: The senior 4 x 440 yards relay of Sexton, Glen, Boreham and Heathfield, won despite good opposition and having already competed during the afternoon in other races.
Jim Heathfield could not hold this place under heavy pressure and dropped back to sixth and handed over to Clive Shippen forty seven seconds in arrears.
